*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Impossible Verisimilitude (Su):** At 6th level, the storytwister tells a story into quasi-reality, creating effects similar to shadow conjuration (save DC 10 + 1/2 bard level + storytwister's Charisma modifier). At 9th level, the spell level limit increases to 4th. At 12th level, the spell level limit is 5th. At 15th level, this effect instead mimics greater shadow conjuration. At 18th level, the spell level limit is 7th.

This bardic performance replaces suggestion, inspire greatness, and mass suggestion.

**See Also:** [[Seraph Bardic Masterpieces]]
